newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Aug retail sales rise 4.9 percent vs yr-ago.
newsitem.headline: Chile Aug retail sales rise 4.9 percent vs yr-ago.

text.p: Chilean retail sales grew 4.9 percent last month against the same period 1995, said the National Chamber of Commerce.
The figure bring the increase in sales in the first eight months to 6.5 percent, a pace slower than that in the January-July period, it said.
August's data together with the 3.2 percent increase recorded in July and the 4.9 percent rise in June point to a sharp slowdown in retail sales growth, said the chamber.
The rise in sales growth between July and August is the result of unusually high sales in the supermarket, footware and clothing sectors, said chamber president Alfonso Mujica.
The figures are the second signal this week that the Central Bank's credit squeeze is succeeded reining in Chile's strong economic growth.
Bank data released Monday showed the economy grew a surprisingly low 5.8 percent in July. Analysts had forecast growth at closer to seven percent.
